audience: support agents and help desk managers who work tickets in HappyFox

useCases.title: Find open tickets by status, priority or assignee
useCases.text: The AI lists or searches tickets with filters such as status, priority and assignee, newest activity first. You see what needs work.

useCases.title: Read a ticket with its full conversation
useCases.text: The AI opens a ticket with its status, priority, assignee, SLA breaches and every update, including messages and private notes. It can sum up the thread.

useCases.title: Check saved reports
useCases.text: The AI lists saved reports, reads their summary counts and shows the ticket rows of a report. You get numbers without opening the Reports module.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their company
useCases.text: The AI finds contacts by name or email, reads one with phones, groups and ticket counts, and opens a contact group with its member contacts.

useCases.title: Reply, add a private note or update a ticket
useCases.text: The AI adds an agent reply or an internal note to a ticket, and can change its status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. The customer is emailed only on a reply when you ask for it.
